entries.title: Psalms 150:1
segments: Praise the LORD. Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in the expanse of His power.

entries.title: Psalms 150:2
segments: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to His excellent greatness.

entries.title: Psalms 150:3
segments: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; praise Him with the harp and lyre.

entries.title: Psalms 150:4
segments: Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; praise Him with stringed instruments and pipes.

entries.title: Psalms 150:5
segments: Praise Him on the sounding cymbals; praise Him with the resounding cymbals.

entries.title: Psalms 150:6
segments: Let everything that breathes praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!
